snippet.title: Astrophobia | Teaser Trailer (Retro Cosmic Horror Indie Game)
snippet.description:
Astrophobia is a PSX-themed retro horror game that is heavily inspired by the novella, At the Mountains of Madness by H.P. Lovecraft. 

In 2001, astronauts Ben Dyer & Henry Danforth are sent to the Moon as part of a secret mission, Project Kadath, to study mysterious architecture far older than humanity. The civilization that built it did not survive, but something else did.

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4476070/Astrophobia

#indiegame #cosmichorror #horrorgame
